sources.title: 豆包大模型 1.6 系列上线边缘大模型网关
sources.evidence: Official Edge Cloud account states the June 11 launch included doubao-seed-1.6-flash. Direct HTML contains the article, official team attribution, and July 2025 publication metadata.

sources.title: Model releases - 2025
sources.evidence: July provider-release table names ByteDance Seed 1.6 Flash 250615 as a low-latency multimodal model with deep thinking enabled by default and switchable off.

sources.title: Model list
sources.evidence: Exact Flash 250615 and 250715 rows list deep reasoning, text generation, multimodal understanding, tool use, and 256K context. They appear under retiring models; documentation is not a live endpoint test.

sources.title: Built on Seed1.6-Flash, Seed-1.6-Embedding Launched
sources.evidence: June 28, 2025 post says its embedding derivative preserves Flash understanding of text, images and video. The stated dual-tower structure describes the embedding derivative, not an exact Flash decoder architecture.

sources.title: Seed1.6 technical introduction
sources.evidence: Indexed primary introduction gives 230B total and 23B active parameters for Seed1.6, without explicitly assigning them to Flash. Live HTML omits the article body. These larger-model counts are not transferred to Flash.

sources.title: Seed1.8 Model Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card checked for exact Flash disclosures; it compares Seed1.6 but does not name Flash or supply Flash parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF and extracted its text after web-reader size failure. No exact Seed1.6 Flash parameter or architecture disclosure found.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card
sources.evidence: Downloaded official PDF and extracted its text after web-reader timeout. No exact Seed1.6 Flash parameter or architecture disclosure found.

sources.title: BytePlus service-specific terms, June 16 2026 version
sources.evidence: Indexed archived Model Services terms reserve model-parameter and framework IP, grant limited service access, and prohibit parameter extraction. Live HTML exposes metadata only. Supports descriptive proprietary service classification, not a weights license.

name.note: Normalized spelling of the exact Flash variant.

developer.note: Named model provider and Seed research publisher.

family.note: Flash is one of the Seed 1.6 series models.

release_date.note: Earliest public launch explicitly includes Flash. July is BytePlus availability; August 28 is a later revision, not this undated model's first release.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is the proprietary hosted service; reviewed first-party materials provide no public Flash checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive service-license classification; no open-weight license is documented.

parameters_b.note: No exact Flash total found in reviewed primary publications or later cards. Seed1.6 230B is not evidence for Flash.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact Flash active count found; do not inherit Seed1.6's 23B.

architecture.note: Flash-specific topology is not disclosed in reviewed sources, including targeted architecture/research searches. Neither Seed1.6 MoE nor the embedding derivative's dual-tower design establishes it.

context_window.note: Official exact-version rows specify 256K; retained as nominal decimal-token notation, rather than a gateway's 262144 interpretation.

modalities.note: The Flash-based embedding post explicitly identifies the base model's text/image/video understanding; model list confirms text generation.

reasoning.note: Flash has optional deep thinking, enabled by default in its original provider announcement.

tool_call.note: Tool use is explicitly listed for both Flash versions.

description.value: ByteDance multimodal model with optional thinking, text, image and video input, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces unsupported extraction/high-throughput positioning with documented capabilities.

patch.description: ByteDance multimodal model with optional thinking, text, image and video input, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Seed 1.6 Flash is separate from Seed1.6: the latter's 230B total / 23B active MoE disclosure does not establish Flash's size or architecture. 256K context is the provider's nominal notation. Earliest public Flash launch was June 11, 2025; later provider dates and snapshot suffixes do not replace it.

sources.label: 豆包大模型 1.6 系列上线边缘大模型网关

summary: Corrects launch to June 11, 2025 and reasoning to true, classifies the hosted model as proprietary, and narrows its description. Confirms nominal 256K, text/image/video input and tool use. Total/active parameters and detailed Flash architecture remain undisclosed after checking later Seed cards; no sibling specifications transferred.
